text_block_list.text: Yawn... H-huh?!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: Where am I? It's pretty and all, but...
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Hello! And welcome to the Adorable ☆

Universe! ♪
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян (?)

text_block_list.text:
It's a special space just for cute lil' Falco,
who's
aspiring to be the world's cutest
Umadol!
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян (?)

text_block_list.text:
A-Adorable ☆ Universe?! Wait a minute.
Why are
you here, Каррен Тян?
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. Well, I know you're always doing
your best
to become your cutest self.
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян (?)

text_block_list.text:
And in response to your super cute
efforts, I've
prepared a super cute
present for you!
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян (?)

text_block_list.text:
Now! Let the light of the Cute ☆ Beam
wash over
you and feel your cuteness
level rise!
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян (?)

text_block_list.text: Shiiing! ☆
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Wh-whoooa! This is i-incredible!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
I can feel the power of cuteness flowing
directly
into my body!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
With this, I'm definitely going to become
the
cutest top Umadol! ♪
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: Falcon... Wake up, Falcon...
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text: Ngh... What is it?
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Huh? Flash? What happened? I thought
I was in
that Universe beam thingy...
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
...It sounds like you were having a
dream. In any
case, I suggest you get up
and change.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
There's approximately twenty minutes
and five
seconds before the school bell
rings... You'll be
late if you don't hurry.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Oh... I see... So everything that
happened was just
a dream.
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
But I still feel the power of cuteness in
me! I know
I can make it before the
bell! ☆
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Thanks to this experience, Смарт Фалкон
improves
her running.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
